description.zh: 实体列表，最多5个；同一批次必须为同一种entityType
description.en: An entity list. You can create up to five entities in a batch. All entities in the batch must have the same `EntityType`.

description.zh: 实体属性，复杂值需要序列化为JSON字符串
description.en: The entity attributes. Complex values must be serialized into a JSON string.

description.zh:
自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value当前仅支持单值。
<notice>这里用到的自定义属性，需要通过CreateCustomAttribute API预先创建，比如通过API创建ID为 `custom-attribute:owner_name`的自定义属性后，这里可以配置 {'owner_name': ['Bob']}完成自定义属性配置</notice>
description.en:
The custom attribute values. The key is the identifier of the custom attribute, and the value is a single-element list.
><notice>The custom attributes used here must be created in advance by using the CreateCustomAttribute API. For example, after you create a custom attribute with the ID `custom-attribute:owner_name`, you can configure the custom attribute by setting this parameter to {'owner\_name': \['Bob']}.></notice>

description.zh:
实体类型, 统一批次须一致，支持
- 纯自定义类型，如custom_entity-biz_api
- 扩展表类型，如果注册了元数据实体类型 custom_dw-table，支持创建对应的数据库类型 custom_dw-database 和 数据表 类型 custom_dw-table的对象
description.en:
The entity type. All entities in a batch must have the same type. The following types are supported:

- Custom types, such as `custom_entity-biz_api`.

- Extended table types. For example, if you have registered the `custom_dw-table` metadata entity type, you can create objects of the corresponding `custom_dw-database` (database) and `custom_dw-table` (table) types.

description.zh: 实体名称，由大小写字母、数字、下划线组成，必须以字母开头，最长64字符
description.en: The entity name. The name can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter and not exceed 64 characters.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买 DataWorks 专业版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Professional Edition or a higher edition to use this operation.
